judged_text: The permission check named isTeamAdminOrOwner joins isTeamAdmin and isTeamOwner with && instead of ||, requiring the caller to be both admin and owner of the booking's team. Team admins who are not owners (and owners who are not admins) are wrongly rejected with FORBIDDEN when adding guests to team bookings, so the authorization control does not implement its own stated admin-or-owner semantics and the feature silently fails for the entire admin role.

Team admins who are not owners (and owners who are not admins) are wrongly rejected with FORBIDDEN when adding guests to team bookings, so the authorization control does not implement its own stated admin-or-owner semantics and the feature silently fails for the entire admin role.

adjudication.rationale: In `addGuests.handler.ts`, `isTeamAdminOrOwner` is computed with `&&` between `isTeamAdmin(...)` and `isTeamOwner(...)`, meaning the user must be both admin and owner to pass (`const isTeamAdminOrOwner = ... && ...`). This contradicts the variable name/intent (“admin or owner”) and will incorrectly reject team admins who aren’t owners (and vice versa) via the subsequent `FORBIDDEN` check (`if (!isTeamAdminOrOwner && !isOrganizer && !isAttendee) ...`).
